projects.note: 45-acre Scotland-themed township (~3,000 homes across 14 2B+G+35 towers, 85% open space) next to Greenwood High; Phase I (566 homes) & Phase II (1,000 homes) K-RERA registered.

clubhouse.details: Four themed clubhouses totalling 1.5 lakh+ sq.ft (including Club Inverness for wellness and Club Glasgow for sports), 3-acre private golf feature, man-made lake, swimming pool, and gymnasium.

news.title: Knight Frank–NAREDCO Sentiment Index Climbs to 56 as Launch & Price Outlook Firm
news.summary: In its 50th edition (Q3 2026), the Current Sentiment Score rose to 56 (from 48) and Future Sentiment Score climbed to 58 (from 50), with 84% expecting stable or higher prices over six months.

news.title: NAREP Real Estate Summit 2026 Convenes DDA & RERA Chairpersons in New Delhi
news.summary: The National Association of Real Estate Professionals hosts the DDA Vice Chairman and multiple RERA Chairpersons on Nov 25 under 'The Next Billion Square Feet' theme on transparency and policy.

news.title: Max Estates' 'The Bungalows' in Gurugram Clocks ₹2,319 Cr Phase 1 Sell-Out
news.summary: HRERA-registered Sector 59 project (RERA-GRG-2322-2026) sold out all 131 Phase 1 residences across 7.7 lakh sq.ft; the 7.25-acre development has 243 homes in two G+42 towers.

news.title: DivyaSree & HDFC Capital Launch ₹1,500 Cr Residential Platform for Chennai, Bengaluru & Hyderabad
news.summary: The joint residential platform targets ₹6,750 Cr in potential gross development value over 3–4 years to expand housing supply across Chennai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad.

news.title: Telangana Housing Board's Indiramma Towers Receive First-Ever TG-RERA Approvals
news.summary: Marking a first for state-led housing in Telangana, TG-RERA approved Indiramma Towers (480 flats per constituency across 16 of 26 ORR constituencies), enabling beneficiary bank loans.

news.title: Brigade Group Acquires 2.25-Acre Secunderabad Site for ₹180 Cr Between MG Road & Necklace Road
news.summary: Brigade Enterprises completed an outright ₹180 Cr purchase of a 2.25-acre Secunderabad parcel (sale deed registered Nov 23, 2026) for a premium residential project with ~₹1,000 Cr revenue potential.

news.title: Supreme Universal Launches Tower C (131 Homes, ₹700 Cr GDV) at Supreme Boulevard, Chembur
news.summary: Phase 2 Tower C of MahaRERA-registered Supreme Boulevard (PR1180002400026) on Deonar Village Road opens with 2, 3 & 4 BHK homes starting at ₹3.05 Cr and Jul 2029 possession.

news.title: Maharashtra Approves ₹53,928 Cr Mumbai Underground Tunnel Network Linking BKC & Airport
news.summary: Cleared by the Maharashtra CM, MMRDA's proposed underground road tunnels will connect BKC, Dharavi, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, and Mumbai Airport to ease surface congestion.

news.title: Supreme Court Directs Noida Authority to Register 7,802 Lotus Greens Sports City Flats
news.summary: The Supreme Court ordered tripartite conveyance registrations for 7,802 Sector 150 Noida flats (Plot SC-02/H&I) within six weeks, exempting the plot from the 20% lien rule.

news.title: Alliance City Developers Hands Over Alliance Eternis in Borivali West After Full OC
news.summary: Following receipt of full Occupation Certificate, Alliance City Developers completed handover of the 14-storey Alliance Eternis tower (MahaRERA: P51800076690) ahead of its Apr 2027 deadline.

news.title: Telangana Plans ₹40,000 Cr Miyapur Auction (386 Acres) & ₹600 Cr Khanamet/Mokila Sales
news.summary: HMDA prepared a draft ~220-plot layout across 386 encroachment-free acres in Miyapur targeting ₹40,000 Cr, alongside Dec 14–21 e-auctions in Khanamet (₹99 Cr/acre base), Mokila (61 plots), Kokapet, and Banjara Hills.

news.title: Birla Niyaara Tower C Slips to Q2 FY28; Aditya Birla Real Estate Targets ₹15,000 Cr by FY29
news.summary: Birla Estates CEO K T Jithendran set a ₹15,000 Cr annual pre-sales goal by FY29 across MMR, Delhi-NCR, Pune, and Bengaluru, while noting Birla Niyaara Tower C's launch shifted to next fiscal after redesign.

news.title: ASBL Legacy at RTC X Roads Records ₹800 Cr Launch-Day Sales Across Three G+50 Towers
news.summary: ASBL's central Hyderabad high-rise (TG-RERA: P02500011162) clocked ₹800 Cr in launch-day bookings across 3 & 4 BHK homes (1,970–3,015 sq.ft), with RERA completion set for Jul 2031.

news.title: Brigade Opens 1,898-Home Floris Phase at Brigade Autograph on Whitefield–Kadugodi Rd
news.summary: Registered under K-RERA (PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/071126/009091), Brigade Autograph Floris offers 1–4 BHK apartments from ₹1.07 Cr to ₹3.99 Cr all-inclusive with Jun 2032 possession.

news.title: MahaRERA Orders Pune's Redshift Buildcon to Execute Conveyance for 204 Buyers in 60 Days
news.summary: MahaRERA directed Redshift Buildcon to register building conveyance for 204 Bloomville flat buyers in Hinjawadi within 60 days and rectify structural defects under Section 14(3) at no cost.

news.title: Tamil Nadu Approves ₹1,401.75 Cr Chennai Housing Plan & Amends TN RERA Rules
news.summary: Tamil Nadu cleared 6,157 EWS/LIG tenements across nine Chennai locations worth ₹1,401.75 Cr following its Nov 6, 2026 amendment to the Tamil Nadu RERA Rules, 2017.

news.title: HSPCB Orders Closure of Godrej Properties' Sector 3 Gurugram Site; TNRERA Fines ₹1 Lakh
news.summary: Haryana State Pollution Control Board ordered work halted at Godrej Properties' Sector 3 Gurugram housing site over dust-control norms, while TNRERA imposed a ₹1 lakh penalty over unauthorized Coimbatore ads.

news.title: MAK Projects Launches MAK Fern 15-Acre Villa Community in Tukkuguda
news.summary: MAK Projects unveiled MAK Fern (TG-RERA: P02400010645), a 15-acre gated community of 109 boutique G+2 4BHK + Home Theatre villas 5 mins from ORR Exit 14, priced from ₹6.79 Cr.

news.title: Hyderabad Unsold Housing Inventory Overhang Reaches 28–30 Months
news.summary: Anarock and CRE Matrix data cited by ThePrint shows 28–30 months of unsold inventory in Hyderabad (longest among top 7 metros), giving homebuyers stronger negotiating power.

news.title: NHB Proposes Separate ₹15 Lakh Affordable Loan Category for Tier-II, III Cities
news.summary: National Housing Bank approached the Department of Financial Services to classify housing loans up to ₹15 lakh in smaller cities as affordable housing to widen buyer credit.

news.title: HMDA Bachupally Plot E-Auction Sees Softer Bidding
news.summary: HMDA's Nov 20 e-auction of 50 Bachupally plots averaged ₹49,737/sq.yd (down from ₹51,991 two months ago), with top bids easing to ₹60,500/sq.yd—signaling more selective buyer bidding in plotted layouts.

news.title: Supreme Court Orders ₹1.57 Cr Refund With 9% Interest Over Undisclosed Litigation
news.summary: The Supreme Court directed a developer to refund ₹1.57 crore with 9% annual interest for failing to disclose pending property litigation, reinforcing homebuyers' right to clear title disclosures.

news.title: TG-RERA Fines Unregistered Project ₹25 Lakh & Orders Buyer Refunds
news.summary: TG-RERA penalized Sanali IT Parks ₹25 lakh for marketing an unregistered Manchirevula project and ordered refunds with interest in multiple delay cases—reminding buyers to verify RERA IDs before booking.

news.title: HMDA Nov 2026 E-Auctions: Inmulnarva, HUDA Heights & Neopolis
news.summary: Following Bachupally, HMDA's November e-auction calendar continues with 45 plots in Inmulnarva (Nov 23), 8 plots in HUDA Heights (Nov 25), and large parcels in Neopolis & Moosapet (Nov 27).

news.title: TG-RERA 4-Month Force Majeure Extension Runs Until Nov 30
news.summary: Registered projects with completion dates between Feb 28 and Jul 31, 2026 received an automatic extension until Nov 30, 2026 under Order No. 1414; buyers should confirm handover schedules in writing.

news.title: JLL Q3 2026: Bengaluru (+15%), Chennai (+12%) & NCR (+10%) Lead Price Gains
news.summary: Residential capital values climbed across India's top cities in Q3 2026—led by Bengaluru (15%), Chennai (12%), Delhi-NCR (10%), Mumbai (8%), and Pune (6%)—driven by demand for larger premium homes.
